title: Rujarkian Hills adventures (shared rules)
summary: Complete the selected Rujarkian Hills adventure objective before its mission timer expires.
overview: Complete the selected Rujarkian Hills adventure objective before its mission timer expires.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Use the adventure status dialogue to track the active objective and time remaining.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Assassination adventures unlock their target after the required kill count; defeat that target to finish.
Kill adventures count eligible deaths, while collection adventures count the requested items when looted.
NPC strength and rewards scale with the requested level and difficulty; optional named enemies and breakable traps populate the adventure.
Finishing after the main timer but before closure can award a partial win.

notes: Approval E280. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
